channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's critical vulnerabilities span desktop operating systems, web applications, cloud infrastructure, and network equipment, with remote code execution and authentication bypass posing the most significant threats. High-profile flaws affect widely deployed platforms including Microsoft Office, BeyondTrust Remote Support, Juniper SRX firewalls, and Tenable Nessus, enabling attackers to compromise endpoints, bypass security controls, and exfiltrate sensitive data. Memory corruption issues such as use-after-free and heap overflows remain prevalent across client software and remote access tools, while web-facing services continue to suffer from injection and authorization weaknesses that threaten data integrity and operational continuity.

item.title: CVE-2026-85936 — Desktop OS
item.description: A double free vulnerability in Windows Shell allows unauthorized network attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, posing a critical threat to endpoint security.

item.title: CVE-2026-108446 — Desktop OS
item.description: Use-after-free in Microsoft Office Excel enables remote code execution via malicious documents, making it highly attractive for widespread phishing campaigns.

item.title: CVE-2026-102764 — Desktop OS
item.description: Actively exploited in the wild, this flaw in BeyondTrust Remote Support allows attackers to perform unauthorized file operations on managed appliances, directly compromising IT infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-111853 — IoT Security
item.description: OS command injection in Tektronix oscilloscope firmware allows remote attackers to execute system commands with elevated privileges, risking full device compromise and data exfiltration.

item.title: CVE-2026-111854 — IoT Security
item.description: Path traversal in the SCPI filesystem interface enables reading and modifying critical device files, undermining laboratory equipment integrity and operational continuity.

item.title: CVE-2026-108334 — Cloud Security
item.description: Improper escaping in the Kuadrant operator's WASM shim can bypass Gateway-level authentication and rate limiting, exposing cloud-native APIs to abuse and unauthorized access.

item.title: CVE-2026-111924 — Cloud Security
item.description: Unauthenticated memory exhaustion via gzip-compressed requests can crash FleetDM servers, disrupting fleet management, patch deployment, and device enrollment workflows.

item.title: CVE-2026-101950 — Network Devices
item.description: Unauthenticated heap overflow in Juniper SRX Junos OS allows remote denial of service and potential code execution via malformed IPv4 packets, directly impacting network perimeter security.

item.title: CVE-2026-111911 — Web Security
item.description: Authentication bypass in phpMyFAQ WebAuthn endpoints allows attackers to register passkeys for any account without validation, severely undermining multi-factor security implementations.

item.title: CVE-2026-104736 — Web Security
item.description: PHP object injection in the LearnPress WordPress plugin enables remote code execution via deserialization of untrusted checkout parameters, widely affecting e-learning and commerce platforms.

item.title: CVE-2026-111866 — Web Security
item.description: Remote SQL injection in nemoTyrant's cache manipulation function allows attackers to extract or modify database contents without authentication, risking complete data breach.

item.title: CVE-2026-103946 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: SQL injection in Tenable Nessus allows authenticated users to read or alter scan data and credentials, compromising vulnerability management operations and internal security posture.

item.title: CVE-2026-106623 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Incorrect authorization in Adobe ColdFusion can lead to sensitive memory disclosure, potentially leaking application secrets, session tokens, or runtime configurations.

item.title: CVE-2026-97381 — Other
item.description: Origin validation flaw in Legacy Update's ActiveX control allows hostname spoofing, enabling malicious updates to install on legacy Windows systems without user detection.

item.title: CVE-2026-111880 — Other
item.description: Heap out-of-bounds write in FreeRDP's NTLM hash-callback path allows unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted RDP messages, impacting remote desktop deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-99999 — Other
item.description: Missing checksum validation in the Linux IPv4 stack can corrupt network headers when processing malformed packets, leading to unpredictable routing behavior or system instability.
